notes: Complete persistent KH2 Final Mix equipment roster: 24 Keyblades, 20 staves, 20 shields, 34 armor and 33 accessories. Temporary tutorial/Limit weapons and fixed guest-party weapons are excluded from the ownable equipment roster.
Final Mix fields override original-release fields; original Japanese cup reward variants are excluded from Final Mix acquisition text.

Stats list the item bonuses/resistances published by the source. Unlisted stat bonuses do not claim an additional benefit. Length is retained as a raw source value but is not displayed as a real-world unit.
Mushroom weapon probabilities are distinct from material rank cutoffs and Jiminy Journal targets. Number IV has no A/S rank; its B rank can award Majestic Mushroom+ at 15%.
Equipment reference entries are read-only so mutually exclusive Roxas rewards do not create an impossible completion goal. Existing Keyblade ownership IDs are preserved by the consumer.
Shop price and vendor fields are sourced here; exact phase-dependent shop availability and repeatable acquisition qualification require the separately documented shop evidence.

Shop inventory unlocks by visiting vendors, not a generic numbered KH2 Shop Level. The Dark Anklet source disagreement is retained on its row. Original positive-price acquisition fields are preserved alongside appended vendor-world/stock-copy guidance.
